title: What Walks at the Reed Edge
summary: Sidony Yoxall says something is out at the edge of Coldharbor: slime trails through flattened reeds. Learn what it is, then put it down.
offer_text: "There is sign at the reed edge: slime trails through flattened reeds. I cannot tell how many, or how bold. Read it for me, and then put them down."
turn_in_text: "Now we know what we are dealing with, and it is dealt with."

objectives.text: Find two signs of the bog toads around the edge of Coldharbor
Tell Sidony Yoxall what you found

relationship.label: Read the sign and acted on it
